headers:
Is the intent for the GPR investigation to cover the entire
cemetery? If not, please identify the anticipated area to
be investigated, preferably to the nearest 0.1 acre.
Requiring consultants to establish investigation limits at
this stage may result in differing assumptions and
potentially exclude investigations that ultimately prove
necessary.

Include a $20,000.00 GPR allowance as a separate line item
in fee proposal and provide the following unit rates:
mobilization, field survey (per day), data processing and
interpretation, and reporting. Please state the approximate
area, in acres, that can be investigated and reported within
the $20,000 allowance. Work under the allowance, per final
contract negotiation, will be authorized in writing by the
City and billed at these rates.The GPR investigation shall be
performed and interpreted by personnel with demonstrated
experience in cemetery and unmarked burial investigations.
